name: Extend Video Turbo
summary: Continues a clip from its last frame with MiniMax H3 and taomate's 3-step turbo LoRA, sound included.

source.notes: Local turbo clone of extend-video (taomate_h3_3step_comfy.safetensors at 3 steps, euler), rebuilt by local/make-turbo-apps.py; the upstream app is untouched.

inputs.label: Your clip
inputs.help: Up to about 15 s; 24 or 25 fps clips join best.

inputs.label: What happens next
inputs.default: The scene continues naturally: same people, place, light and camera style.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: The turbo LoRA is trained for 3 steps; more steps cost time and usually add nothing. Fewer look rougher.

inputs.label: Sampler
inputs.help: euler is what the turbo LoRA was trained with; res_multistep is the plain app's sampler, smoother at equal steps but slower to settle at 3 or 4.

inputs.label: Sparse attention (H3 SLA)
inputs.help: The ROCm SLA node. Turn it off on CUDA/XPU, or on a backend that does not ship it: the node is bypassed and the model goes straight to the sampler. It is also bypassed automatically when the backend lacks the class.

notes: The same graph as Extend Video with taomate's 3-step LoRA (strength 1.0) on the diffusion model and the sampler set to euler at 3 steps. The clip's last frame starts the new part and the frames and sound are joined after it, as upstream. Local turbo variant, not part of the video-h3 pack: freefield's catalogue has no Hub entry for taomate_h3_3step_comfy.safetensors, so it is not downloaded with the pack. Keep the file in ComfyUI/models/loras.
